args.body:
Hi Tomas,

I hope you're well. I'm writing to let you know that we'll be paying the £250 deposit for the hall by Friday, 13 November.

Thanks very much for your help, and please don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything further from our side.

Best regards,
Alex
